formulas.name: Max Membrane Integrity
formulas.formula: 12 + VSC*4 + Hull + 2*(Level-1) + 6 per Stage past I + graft and Adaptation bonuses

formulas.name: Membrane Threshold
formulas.formula: 10 + DFF + graft, size and condition modifiers

actions.name: Strike
actions.pool: by Apparatus class: Weight VSC + Membrane Penetration; Lash DFF + Membrane Penetration; Projector DFF or RTC + Membrane Penetration; Resonator RTC + Catalysis; plus the Apparatus bonus
actions.target: one body in the weapon's band

actions.name: Drift
actions.legal: own turn; leaving Contact with a foe there invites a Flank Breach

actions.name: Hold a Reserve
actions.legal: own turn; one held at a time (two with Twin Reserve)

actions.name: Sense
actions.against: the hidden thing's DFF + Concealment, or the site's printed Threshold

actions.name: Use a Vial
actions.target: self or an ally at Contact
actions.legal: own turn (a Synthesise action); free outside a fight

actions.name: Harvest
actions.pool: OSM or RTC + Synthesis (+2 dice with a Harvesting tool)
actions.target: a destroyed creature at Contact, or the site where its record allows
actions.legal: own turn, or 10 minutes outside a fight (then no roll if pool*3 meets the Threshold)

actions.name: Pull a Lodged weapon
actions.target: self or an ally at Contact
actions.legal: own turn (a Synthesise action); deals 4 damage

actions.name: Burst
actions.legal: own turn; knows the Burst; not Locked

actions.name: Overdrive
actions.legal: before the roll; 4 ATP for +2 dice or 4 MI for +4 dice and 1 Stress; once per roll

actions.name: Assist
actions.legal: same Pathway, in reach; +1 die, at most two helpers

actions.name: Swear an Oath
actions.legal: a witness the site lists is present; an Oath box is free

actions.name: React (Deflect, Inhibit, Brace, Shed, Flank Breach)
actions.legal: holding a Reserve; one reaction per Cycle

apparatus.name: Cryo Vent

apparatus.name: Suture Cannon

apparatus.name: Harvest Claw

properties.note: The book names it but gives no rule.

grafts.name: Osmotic Filter

grafts.name: Scent Dampener

grafts.name: Secondary Lens

grafts.name: Deep Ear

grafts.name: Flagellar Motor

vials.name: Terminal Dropper

phenotypes.name: Acidic Corrosor

signature.name: ETCH
signature.text: Every Lytic hit you land marks **1 Etch** on the target (max 5, one creature at a time visible to you; you can *move* your Etch focus by spending 1 PP). Etch is spent, on your turn, for any combination:

stages.name: Digest Armour
stages.text: Your own grafts are acid-hardened: +1 soak vs Lytic; when an attacker uses Lytic damage on you, they take `1 + Stage` Lytic back.

stages.name: Spreading Taint
stages.text: A Runaway Catalysis on a Lytic hit marks Etch on **one other** creature in Near band. Etch max rises to 6.

stages.name: Unbound Appetite
stages.text: You may spend Etch on **structures and terrain**: eat a wall, a gate, a Gel zone, a hazard. 3 Etch = a 4-Drift hole in anything of tier below yours.

stages.name: Total Dissolution
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, spend all Etch on a target: it takes `4 × Stage` Lytic damage ignoring all soak. If this takes it below 0 MI, its body is **erased**: no Harvest, no Re-Synthesis, no Legacy for anyone. This is the most feared sentence in the Expanse.

phenotypes.kit: Acid Duct (120 S if affordable, else Spore Pistol), Lytic-friendly graft (Lipid Wrap), 2 Vials.

phenotypes.name: Membrane Breacher

signature.name: BREACH CHARGE
signature.text: Whenever your attack beats a target's MT by **6 or more** (i.e. Overflow ≥ 6 against its Membrane Threshold), you **Breach** it:

stages.name: Forced Entry
stages.text: You ignore the first 3 points of soak from any Testate or Fibrous graft when you Strike. Doors never cost you a Synthesise action: 1 PP.

stages.name: Rupture Push
stages.text: A Breach also throws the target **1 band** away from you (its choice of axis). Enemies that hit a wall take 4 Kinetic and become Jostled.

stages.name: Spatial Breach
stages.text: Spend a Breach to open a **hole in a membrane or a zone**: any ally may move as a free Drift through it, and the passage lasts until the end of the next Cycle. Walls become suggestions; this is how you rescue someone from Sequester.

stages.name: Rupture Protocol
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, before you roll a Strike, declare it: if it hits, **treat its Overflow as 8** (Breach triggers, and damage is computed with 8). Against structures, this destroys anything below tier 4 outright.

phenotypes.kit: Pressure Ram or Chitin Flail, Pore Locks graft if you can, Harvest Claw optional.

phenotypes.name: Enzymatic Splicer

signature.name: SPLICE
signature.text: As a Synthesise action (2 PP), you may perform one **Splice** on a creature within Mid band. A Splice moves something that already exists:

stages.name: Field Revision
stages.text: Your Substrate Patch and Mend-style heals also end one condition of *your* choice on the target, not the target's choice.

stages.name: Rank Splice
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, for 3 Cycles, move **1 Pathway rank** from one creature in Contact to another. A hostile's catalysis just dropped a die; your Kinetic Striker suddenly knows Fluid Navigation.

stages.name: Type Splice
stages.text: As part of a Splice, change the **damage type** of an ally's next Strike or Burst to any type you choose (they must still be able to cause it — you are rewriting what the wound *does*). Synergy: an Antibody Archer's Kinetic bolt becomes Genetic and stops caring about Testate plate.

stages.name: Chimera Sequence
stages.text: Once per scene, graft one **Harvest trait** from a Specimen you carry onto any creature in range for `Stage` Cycles. Enemies can receive them too. The Director should let this be creative: a Phagocyte Guard wearing a *Wraith's Phase-Lattice* is a legal, terrible idea.

phenotypes.kit: Suture Cannon if affordable, Needle Dagger, Mucoid Mantle later (you will be near the damage).

phenotypes.name: Detritus Reclaimer

signature.name: SALVAGE
signature.text: You convert dead matter into a pool. **Harvesting is free for you** (no action, no contest, tier +8 AT waived) and yields **Salvage points** equal to the creature's tier (Catastrophes: 4). Salvage max = `RTC + Stage`. You spend Salvage:

stages.name: Efficient Gleaner
stages.text: Your Harvest checks take no time outside combat, and your Cohort's Harvest rolls gain +2 dice. You always know, by smell, what died within Far band.

stages.name: Cycle Doctrine
stages.text: When any creature dies within Mid band, gain 1 Salvage. You may spend Salvage at range on allies' grafts (they must be in range of your signal).

stages.name: Reclaimer's Field
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, spend 4 Salvage: everything in a 4-Drift zone is *digested into you*: you gain 3 MI per creature, allies gain 1 ATP per creature, and hostile Harvest traits are suppressed for the scene.

stages.name: Return to the Cycle
stages.text: Once per Tide, target a creature that Total-Lysed within the last Beat. It rises as a **Reclaimed** ally at half MI, with one Pathway rank less, and owes you a debt the table should absolutely make painful. It is not your character. It is a person made of the person who died.

phenotypes.kit: Harvest Claw (90 S — buy it first), heavy Apparatus, Vacuole Sac.

phenotypes.name: Protein Weaver

signature.name: FOLD TOKENS
signature.text: You have **Fold Tokens = RTC** (max 8), refreshed at each Reconstitution and by spending 1 PP to re-knot (1 token per Cycle, max 2/Cycle). Spend tokens to fold protein into the world:

stages.name: Read the Grain
stages.text: You can tell, by touch, what a structure is made of, its weak type, and roughly how much MI it has. Structures you craft gain +5 MI.

stages.name: Living Sheet
stages.text: Your walls **regenerate** 4 MI per Cycle if you spend 1 ATP, and you may set one wall to be *selective*: you choose a chemistry (an Order, a lineage, a pheromone) that passes through it freely. Colonies pay fortunes for this.

stages.name: Tensile Works
stages.text: Your Folds can be **loaded**: as a Synthesise action, store an ally's Strike inside a wall or net (up to `Stage` charges). Anyone can then release it: the stored damage fires at MT 12 from the structure. Ambush engineering.

stages.name: Cathedral Fold
stages.text: Once per Tide, spend 8 tokens: a **permanent structure** (a gatehouse, a span, a fortress-shell) appears in one region, sized to district scale, and it changes that region's travel routes. It has MI 400, can house a colony, and every faction in the Codex will have an opinion about it.

phenotypes.kit: Grapple Tendril, Chitin Spurs, Fibrous Lattice Vest.

phenotypes.name: Peptide Constructor

signature.name: ASSEMBLY
signature.text: You build **Constructs**: simple bodies of folded protein and harvested tissue. A Construct's block (also printed in the Bestiary's *Colony Constructs* section):

stages.name: Standing Orders
stages.text: Each Construct carries one programmed instruction (guard a band, carry Bulk, block a charge, hand you a Vial). It triggers without your PP. A Construct obeying a standing order acts without costing you Command PP.

stages.name: Inserted Doctrine
stages.text: When you build, install one **Harvest trait** from a Specimen you carry (a Construct with a *Spore Hound's* Lodged barb, or a *Swarm's* Segments). One trait per Construct.

stages.name: Linked Line
stages.text: Two of your Constructs may share a Reserve pool and a sense: if one is hit, the other learns the attacker's position and may react. Also: your Constructs gain **+1 PP** when adjacent to another Construct.

stages.name: Foundry
stages.text: You may establish a permanent Foundry in a colony: Constructs build there for half cost and one Fugue Interval, and in a Pulse War you may **assemble in combat** (4 PP, 40 S, no contest, at your Tier − 1). You control up to **3 + ⌊RTC ÷ 2⌋**. A Foundry is a political asset: the Hegemony will licence it, tax it, or try to own it.

phenotypes.kit: Suture Cannon or Barbed Launcher, Vacuole Sac, 60 S reserved for builds.

phenotypes.name: Amino Acid Smith

signature.name: TUNE
signature.text: As a Synthesise action on an item within Contact, tune it for the scene. Choose **one**:

stages.name: Honest Work
stages.text: Your crafting costs −20% Substrate, and you can appraise any item by tasting it: you always know its rarity, its Minor Cost if hidden, and whether it is parasitic.

stages.name: Overcharge
stages.text: As above, but the effect doubles (+4 BD, or +4 dice, or +4 soak) and the item must win a **durability check**: roll 2d6, on 6 or less the item is **destroyed** at the end of the scene. You may overcharge your own graft and take the destruction Stress willingly.

stages.name: Field Forge
stages.text: Once per scene, spend 1 PP and 20 S: produce one Common Apparatus or graft from your kit list, already installed. You may also repair **permanent** soak loss (Corrodes, Brittle, Acidic surge) on one item per Reconstitution.

stages.name: Masterwork Sequence
stages.text: Once per Tide, grant a **permanent Rider** to one item you have owned for at least a Tide: pick from the catalogue or design one with the Director at the value of an Uncommon property. A Masterwork is a named object; it will outlive you and be fought over. Items can hold one Masterwork Rider ever.

phenotypes.kit: Harvest Claw, Chitin Flail, 40 S in spare parts.

phenotypes.name: Ribozyme Engineer

signature.name: TEMPLATE
signature.text: When you **observe** a Burst, a Fold, or a creature's printed Special action used within your senses, you may spend 1 PP to attempt a **Template**: Sequence Reading contest vs `8 + (2 × its tier)`, at −2 dice if it was a creature's alien action. On success you hold a Template of it.

stages.name: Annotated Margin
stages.text: When you Template from an ally's Burst, they keep it: you both have it. Their pool for that Burst gains +1 die this scene (they are watching you do their work and improving).

stages.name: Printed Dose
stages.text: Spend 1 Substrate and 2 PP to print a Template into a **Vial**: any creature (including an ally or an enemy, if they can be tricked) can fire it as a Synthesise action at the printed tier. Vial-Templates are the black market's favourite object.

stages.name: Revision
stages.text: A Template you hold may be **revised** once: change its range band, its damage type, or its target from ally to enemy (or back). Revising costs 2 Stress: you are arguing with the sequence.

stages.name: Write a New Sequence
stages.text: Design your **own Burst** with the Director: choose domain, tier, cost, and effect within the Core's guardrails (no more than one new condition per Burst). It becomes a permanent entry on your sheet, learnable by others (which is a story in itself), and a copy exists somewhere the moment you use it.

phenotypes.kit: AE Crucible if affordable (450 S, save for it), Needle Dagger, Secondary Lens.

phenotypes.name: Current Rider

signature.name: SLIPSTREAM
signature.text: When you move at least **3 Drifts** in a Cycle (by your own Drift or by a current), gain **1 Slip**, up to **Stage + 2** stored. Spend Slip for any one:

stages.name: Reads Water
stages.text: You always know the Flow, viscosity, and tonic state of a scene as a free action, and currents never force saves against you. Flow +2.

stages.name: Wake Cutter
stages.text: When you leave a Contact band, no Flank Breach is provoked (you cut the wake). Momentum now needs only 2 Drifts and grants +1 PP as well as the dice.

stages.name: Standing Wave
stages.text: As a Reactive (your Reserve), when an attack against you **fails**, you may spend 1 Slip to shove the attacker 1 band and make it Jostled. Misses are ammunition.

stages.name: Confluence
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, declare Confluence: for **3 Cycles** you choose the field's Flow direction and strength (up to 3) at the start of each of your turns, and you may Split Frequency without limit. Flagellans call this *the Long Ride*. Afterwards, mark 3 Stress and you must spend a Reconstitution eating 20 S of Substrate.

phenotypes.kit: Flagellar whip or Grapple Tendril, Flagellar Motor graft as soon as affordable, Lipid Weave.

phenotypes.name: Turbulence Navigator

signature.name: CHART
signature.text: As a 2-PP action, you **chart** a zone (radius `3 + Stage` Drifts) for `1 + ⌈Stage ÷ 2⌉` Cycles, setting one of:

stages.name: Chart Read
stages.text: At the start of a Pulse War you announce the field's terrain numbers and any hazard the Director has hidden (they are not hidden from you; describe what you smell). Hazards you have seen can be *rerouted*: move a hazard 2 Drifts, 1 PP.

stages.name: Redirect
stages.text: As a Reactive, when an ally is pushed, swept, or Sequestered, you may change the destination band (including "back where they came from"). Costs 1 PP.

stages.name: Manufactured Current
stages.text: As a 2-PP action, create a **Current** (strength up to Stage) anywhere you can sense, for 3 Cycles. It can be vertical, diagonal, or *out of* a wall. Bestiary sweeps and Nutrient Currents count as allies now.

stages.name: Rewrite the Flow
stages.text: **Downtime:** permanently alter a region's current routing — a trade route closes, a valley floods, a colony's water changes. Every faction reacts (Codex Ch. IV). **In combat:** once per Pulse War, for 3 Cycles you set the **entire field's** viscosity, Flow, and tonic band (one choice), and your charts cost 0 PP.

phenotypes.kit: Tuning Fork of the Deep Flow (500 S, save for it), Barbed Launcher, Osmotic Filter.

phenotypes.name: Pheromological Messenger

signature.name: BROADCAST CHARGES
signature.text: You have **AFF + Stage** Broadcast Charges, and you regain **1 at the start of each of your Cycles**. A charge buys a free signal (no PP, no roll) to any creature you can sense:

stages.name: Interpreter
stages.text: You can speak any region's dialect by tasting it, and you always know when someone is lying *to someone else*. You may spend a charge to let an ally understand anything said, anywhere in the scene.

stages.name: False Chorus
stages.text: Once per scene, produce a **False Scent** (Core Bursts, Galvanic III) at half cost, at your own Tier's Effect Value. Creatures that attack the phantom waste a Cycle; they know it was a trick and that has consequences.

stages.name: Chorus Command
stages.text: Your Rally, Halt, and Mark can target **every creature in one band** for the same charge cost. This is the moment a Messenger stops being support and becomes a commander.

stages.name: The Ninefold Name
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, speak a **name** at one creature (any tier; Catastrophes gain +4 to the save): it must win OSM at AT `12 + (Stage × 2)` or suffer −2 to all pools for 2 Cycles **and obey one short sentence you give it** ("leave", "hold", "stop", "turn"). A named creature never forgets who named it. Roll 1d6 after; on 1, the name reached something further away than the target.

phenotypes.kit: Needle Scatter or Spore Pistol, Signal Vane graft (400 S — buy it), Pheromone Mask Vials.

phenotypes.name: Kinetic Striker

signature.name: IMPACT
signature.text: A Strike made after moving **3+ Drifts** (Momentum, Core §4.3) marks **Impact** on the target (max `Stage × 2`). Impact is a debt you collect later:

stages.name: Long Run
stages.text: Momentum triggers at 2 Drifts, and Momentum's bonus becomes **+3 Reagents** (or +4 in a current). Flow +1.

stages.name: Riposte of Arrival
stages.text: As a Reactive Osmosis, you may make one Strike as part of the same Reserve: if the attacker is moving toward you, your Strike gains Momentum automatically. You want to be attacked.

stages.name: Cascade Collection
stages.text: When a Strike hits with **Overflow 4+**, your next Strike this Cycle (against any target) gains +3 Overflow — motion is not spent, it is *re-directed*.

stages.name: Unanswered Motion
stages.text: Once per Pulse War: at the start of your turn, declare it. You gain **an extra full set of PP this Cycle** (refresh everything), you cannot hold a Reserve until your next turn, and you mark 3 Stress. Every Strike this Cycle that hits pushes 1 band for free. Veteran Strikers call this *arriving twice*.

phenotypes.kit: Pressure Ram or Chitin Flail, Momentum-property Apparatus (Barbed Launcher), Chitin Spurs.

phenotypes.name: Genetic Hijacker

signature.name: INSERT
signature.text: As a Synthesise action (2 PP, Mid band) or on a **Genetic**-type hit, attempt an Insert: a contested Sequence Reading against the target's OSM + Pressure Tolerance. Success installs **one Insert** on the target (max `1 + Stage` at once). Each Insert does one thing, chosen when installed:

stages.name: Reading the Host
stages.text: Free action: you know a creature's Order, tier, and one Harvest trait by scent. Inserts you install on a creature you have read gain +2 to their save DC.

stages.name: Recombinant Payload
stages.text: When an Insert is removed or ends, you may capture it as a **Pristine Sequence** (1 Bulk). These are the raw material of high grafting and Re-Synthesis — and the most addictive loot in the game.

stages.name: Competitive Exclusion
stages.text: An Insert of yours on a target **blocks** any hostile Genetic effect against it: you are not only hijacking, you are *preventing*. This is the single best answer to a Pathogenic Wraith, and Wraiths will prioritise killing you accordingly.

stages.name: Permanent Insertion
stages.text: Once per Tide, at AT 20 (no contest reduction; Catastrophes gain +4): take **one Pathway rank** or **one Harvest trait** from a creature you have an Insert on. It is yours until a Nucleoid-grade Mend restores it. The creature remembers. So does the Warden Circles.

phenotypes.kit: Needle Dagger (Lodged, Silent), Sequence Key Vials, Mucoid Mantle.

phenotypes.name: Pathogen Scout

signature.name: VECTORS
signature.text: You have **OSM + Stage** Vector doses, refreshed at a Reconstitution. Seed a Vector (1 PP, Contact, or loaded into a Lodged Apparatus hit, or left on a surface):

stages.name: Field Inoculation
stages.text: Your Vectors work on **structures and terrain**: seed a wall, a gate, a colony's water supply. A structure carrying a Vector is a bomb, and you are the only one who knows.

stages.name: Latent Period
stages.text: A Vector may now be set to trigger after **up to one Metabolic Beat** of your choosing, or on a stated condition ("when it enters the Hegemony's registry hall"). Intrigue becomes mechanical. The Codex's *Bloom of Ash* is built around a Stage II Scout's decision.

stages.name: Bloom Trigger
stages.text: As a 3-PP action, detonate **every Vector you have seeded within Far band** simultaneously. Each trigger fires at −1 Effect Value, and you regain 1 dose per creature affected.

stages.name: PANDORA
stages.text: Once per Tide, seed a **region**: every organism in it acquires a latent Vector for one Tide. You may trigger all of them at once, at full Effect Value, in a scene you choose. After, mark 4 Lysis Countdown boxes (your body pays for the scale) and every faction with any interest in that region will know your chemical name. This is not a combat ability. It is a campaign ending.

phenotypes.kit: Needle Scatter, Barbed Launcher, Pheromone Mask, Scent Dampener graft.

phenotypes.name: Viral Mimic

signature.name: CAMOUFLAGE
signature.text: As a 2-PP action, contest **DFF + Concealment** against a subject (or the local antigen register, AT 14 + tier). Success: you wear a creature's chemistry.

stages.name: Worn Face
stages.text: You can camouflage an **object** or a corpse instead: a body you wear gives you its Harvest traits (one, at −1 tier) and lets a companion believe your dead friend is still walking. This is legal in exactly one region.

stages.name: Borrowed Function
stages.text: While camouflaged you may use **one printed Special action** of the creature you are wearing, at your own Tier's Effect Value, once per scene. The first time you do this with a creature type, mark 1 Stress: your body protests.

stages.name: Hive Mask
stages.text: Extend camouflage to `Stage` willing creatures in Contact, at 1 charge each per Cycle. A Cohort wearing an Immunan patrol's chemistry can walk a Warden checkpoint. The checkpoint has a register, and registers notice *gaps*.

stages.name: Unbound
stages.text: Permanently bind one camouflaged identity: you keep its Gift, one Harvest trait, and its size class **without upkeep**, and you may now wear a **specific individual** you have studied for a Fugue Interval — including their voice-chemistry, their Oath standing, and their enemies. When you are Unbound as someone else, a Total Lysis returns you to your own body (one scar, rolled) — which makes you the only organism who can survive a death by not being yourself.

phenotypes.kit: Needle Dagger, Signal Vane, Graft Antidote Vials (you will need them).

phenotypes.name: Replicator Agent

signature.name: BUDDING
signature.text: As a 3-PP action, split: a **Bud** appears adjacent.

stages.name: Shared Sense
stages.text: Free action, once per Cycle: perceive through any Bud. Buds can see each other and you, at any distance in the same region.

stages.name: Strand Transfer
stages.text: As a 1-PP action, move one **condition**, one **Insert**, one **Mark**, or **2 Stress** from yourself to a Bud, or from an ally in Contact to a Bud. You are a lightning rod for everyone's bad day.

stages.name: Differentiation
stages.text: Each Bud takes a *different* Stage feature and gains **+1 PP**. Additionally, while at least two Buds live, you gain **+1 PP** (you are thinking in more than one place). You may now Budd at 2 PP.

stages.name: Colony of One
stages.text: When you would suffer **Total Lysis**, instead transfer to a living Bud (free, before anything else happens): you survive at that Bud's MI, but you lose **one Level of Codon**, roll twice on the Legacy Scarring table and keep one, and every Sequence-reading authority in the region learns that you cannot be killed this way. Once per Tide. The Hegemony has a standing bounty on Stage IV Replicators; the Codex explains why.

phenotypes.kit: Peptide Blade, Full Testate Carapace when affordable, ATP Capacitor Cells.

phenotypes.name: Antigen Detector

signature.name: ASSAY
signature.text: As a 1-PP action (or free once per Cycle when you have not acted), assay a creature within Far band: contest **OSM + Chemoreception** against its Concealment or its natural stealth. Success marks it, and you name its **epitope** — one damage type. While marked:

stages.name: Antigen Sight
stages.text: Camouflage, False Scent, Masked, and inserted sequences are visible to you as *wrongness*: you may attempt the assay contest as a free action, and revealing a disguise is a Mark for free. Immunan patrols hire Detectives for this and never thank them.

stages.name: Registry of Enemies
stages.text: Once per **creature type** (per Cohort, permanent): you know everything printed on its Bestiary block — traits, tactics, harvest — and the Cohort's Harvest checks against it gain +2 dice. Saying it aloud is a free action; the information is diegetic, not meta.

stages.name: Preemptive Recognition
stages.text: When a creature Begins a Burst, Charges, or prepares a Strike, you may assay it **immediately, before it resolves**. If its action then fails for any reason, your Cohort gains **+1 PP this Cycle**. Detectives are the reason ambushes stop working.

stages.name: Pan-Registry
stages.text: As a 4-PP action: every hostile in a zone (`4 + Stage` Drifts) is Marked, every hidden thing in the zone is revealed, and for 3 Cycles all allied attacks against Marked targets gain +2 Reagents and ignore 1 soak. The zone stays *readable* for the rest of the scene. After, you must Vent (1 PP) or mark 2 Stress: knowing everything is heavy.

phenotypes.kit: Needle Scatter or Spore Pistol, Secondary Lens graft, Memory Vial.

phenotypes.name: Phagocyte Guard

signature.name: ENGULF
signature.text: When an attack or area effect would hit an ally within **Contact** (Near at Stage II+), spend your Reserve: **you take it instead**, with **+4 soak** applied. Then, if the attacker is your size class or smaller and you took 6+ damage from it, you may attempt **Engulfment**: contested **VSC + Pressure Tolerance** vs its VSC. Success:

stages.name: Bulwark Reflex
stages.text: Allies in Contact gain **+2 MT**. As a 1-PP action, give an ally in Contact **+3 soak** until your next turn.

stages.name: Extended Self
stages.text: Engulf reaches Near band. You cannot be Flank-Breached, and you may position yourself **between** two allies: both count as Contact for your features.

stages.name: Digestion
stages.text: Lytic damage from Engulfment doubles, and you gain **+1 temporary MI** per point of damage the engulfed creature takes (max `Stage × 4`, gone at Reconstitution). You may also expel an engulfed creature *through* a Strike: release it at another target as an attack at BD = Stage.

stages.name: Antigen Bulwark
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, for **3 Cycles**: all damage dealt to any ally within your bands is reduced by your full soak; you gain **+2 PP**; you cannot be pushed or moved; and each time you reduce damage this way, that ally gains +1 ATP. You may not Drift on those Cycles. Guards call this *standing where the wall was*.

phenotypes.kit: Pressure Ram or Bony Flail, Testate or Somatic graft (you want soak), Pore Locks, Coagulant Packs.

phenotypes.name: Antibody Archer

signature.name: LOCK
signature.text: A successful Strike against a creature marks **1 Lock** on it (max 3 per creature). Each Lock:

stages.name: Known Epitope
stages.text: Against a creature an ally has **Marked**, your attacks gain **+2 Reagents**, and you may spend 1 Cohesion to *reload certainty*: re-roll one Inhibitor on the attack.

stages.name: Avidity
stages.text: When you reach Lock 3 on a target, you may make one extra Strike this Cycle against a **different** creature in range at −1 Reagent. Cross-reactivity is a real immune phenomenon; here it is free damage.

stages.name: Cross-Reaction
stages.text: When a Strike hits with **Overflow 4+**, your next Strike this Cycle against a *different* creature carrying at least one Lock gains **+2 Reagents and +1 Overflow** — the response spreads.

stages.name: Classical Response
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, as a 4-PP action: choose one creature in Far band. Make **three Strikes** at your full Lock bonus; each hit applies **Lock 3 instantly** and, on the third, the target suffers a **Perfect Match** with the type you choose. Immune lore calls this *the answer that arrives all at once*.

phenotypes.kit: Needle Scatter (200 S) or Barbed Launcher, Secondary Lens, Antibody Barb Vials.

phenotypes.name: Complement Cascade Commander

signature.name: CASCADE
signature.text: When an ally hits a creature **you have marked or Lock-flagged**, you may spend **1 PP** to trigger a Cascade: **one other ally** within Far band makes one free Strike against any creature that is marked or Lock-flagged, at **+1 Overflow**. Restrictions: one Cascade per ally per Cycle, and at most **AFF + Stage** Cascades per Pulse War (track them on the sheet — they are your ammunition).

stages.name: Rally Field
stages.text: Allies within Mid band gain **+1 Reagent** on their first Strike each Cycle. You know, as a free action, how many PP each ally has left — say so constantly.

stages.name: Marker Spread
stages.text: When you mark a creature, you may (free) pass the mark to **one adjacent creature** as well, at no cost. With enough Cascades you can turn a whole fight into a chain: a single Cycle with 4 Cascades is called a *classical response* and is remembered for Beats.

stages.name: Classical Pathway
stages.text: As a 3-PP action, once per Pulse War: every creature you have marked takes `4 + (Stage × 2)` Voltaic damage, every ally in Mid band heals `2 × number of marks` MI, and all conditions of the **Marked** type are removed from allies. Your OSM hums; the region hears it.

stages.name: Membrane Attack Complex
stages.text: As a 5-PP action, once per Pulse War: choose up to **three creatures within Mid band of each other**. A protein-complex lattice closes over them: they are **Sequestered** (Core IV) at AT `16 + your Overflow`, and for as long as the lattice holds (your choice, up to 3 Cycles) **allied attacks against them gain +2 Reagents and cannot be defended by Reactive Osmosis**. When any Sequestered creature inside dies, every ally gains **+2 ATP and +2 MI**. MACs are the reason the Hegemony's enemies organise in groups.

phenotypes.kit: Phase Bell (180 S) or Needle Scatter, Signal Vane graft, Chain Cascade Vials.

phenotypes.name: Acid-Resistant Tank

signature.name: VAT
signature.text: You keep a internal reservoir of **Acid charges**, max **RTC + Stage**. Gain 1 charge when:

stages.name: Acid-Hardened
stages.text: Lytic damage against you is reduced by **2 + Stage**. Anything that deals Lytic damage to you in Contact takes **Stage** Lytic back (it touched the wrong bag of chemistry).

stages.name: Swallow
stages.text: As a Reactive Osmosis, absorb a ranged Lytic or Thermal effect targeting you or an ally in Contact: **0 damage, +1 Acid charge.** Tanks are the only beings who treat an acid attack as a *reloading* action.

stages.name: Shared Bath
stages.text: While you hold **3+ charges**: +2 soak for you, +1 soak vs Lytic for allies in Contact, and as a Synthesise action you may **coat** an ally's Apparatus: it deals Lytic damage and **+2 BD** for the scene (and needs Neutralising before it eats their hands).

stages.name: The Long Burn
stages.text: Once per Pulse War, for **3 Cycles**: a zone of radius `Stage × 2` Drifts becomes Acidic for hostile organisms only. You gain **+2 PP** and regenerate **3 MI** per Cycle there; every hostile action there costs +1 ATP. Afterwards the ground stays hostile for a Beat, which is a *colony problem* you now own.

phenotypes.kit: Osmotic Maul or Chitin Flail, Mucoid Mantle (your best friend), Neutraliser Vials for the Cohort.

phenotypes.name: Thermal Diver

signature.name: GRADIENT
signature.text: You carry a **Gradient** from **−5 (deep-cold)** to **+5 (white-hot)**, starting at 0. At the start of your turn you may shift it **1 for free, 2 for 1 PP**; taking Thermal damage shifts it toward hot by the damage ÷ 3 (rounded); entering a cold region shifts it toward cold by 1.

stages.name: Thermal Indifference
stages.text: Choose hot or cold regions: they are Isotonic-equivalent for you (this is in addition to your Barophil *Hardened*). Thermal damage against you is reduced by **Stage**.

stages.name: Flash Point
stages.text: As a Reactive Osmosis, convert incoming Thermal damage entirely into a Gradient shift (toward hot, by damage ÷ 2) and push the attacker **1 band**. You may do this against your own ally's Burst if you are willing.

stages.name: Steam Vent
stages.text: As a 3-PP action, once per Pulse War: a zone of radius `3 + Stage` Drifts flashes: `6 + |Gradient| × 2` Thermal damage to hostiles, everything in the zone is pushed **1 band**, and the zone becomes **Turbid** for 2 Cycles. Cold-Gradient version: the zone becomes viscous for 3 Cycles instead.

stages.name: Critical Point
stages.text: Once per Pulse War: set Gradient to **+5 or −5 immediately**, and for **2 Cycles** you suffer none of its Stress or Flow cost and your Effect Values gain +4. When it ends, Gradient returns to 0, you take **10 damage**, and mark 3 Stress. Divers call it *the dive you only make once*.

phenotypes.kit: Cryo Vent (300 S, save for it), Enzyme Horn, Heat Sink graft.

phenotypes.name: Osmotic Brute

signature.name: TURGOR
signature.text: You build **Turgor** charges, max **Stage + 3**. Gain 1 when: you take Osmotic or Kinetic damage; you successfully push or are pushed; you spend 2 ATP to pump fluid; or you win a Pressure Tolerance save.

stages.name: Immovable
stages.text: You cannot be pushed by anything with VSC less than yours. +2 soak vs Osmotic, and Momentum attacks against you lose their bonus dice.

stages.name: Pore Grapple
stages.text: When a Strike hits, you may spend 1 Turgor to **Anchor** the target: it cannot Drift until it wins a VSC contest at AT 12 + your Overflow. You can hold one Anchor at a time (two at Stage III).

stages.name: Pressure Wave
stages.text: Your Strike can be declared along a **line** (up to `Stage × 2` Drifts): every creature in the line is attacked at −1 Reagent each, and all are pushed 1 band. Brutes clear corridors.

stages.name: Implosion
stages.text: Once per Pulse War: a target in Contact. Spend **all** Turgor: it takes **3 damage per point** (Osmotic, ignores all soak) and everything else within `3 + Stage` Drifts is thrown **2 bands** for 4 Osmotic damage each. Then you are **Flaccid** for 2 Cycles (−2 VSC, reach −1). A Brute that uses Implosion on a swarm usually ends the swarm and starts a funeral.

phenotypes.kit: Pressure Ram (60 S — this is your class weapon), Full Testate Carapace later, Pore Locks.

phenotypes.name: Desiccation Specialist

signature.name: DRY ZONE
signature.text: As a 2-PP action, make a zone of radius **2 + Stage** Drifts **Dry** for `1 + ⌈Stage ÷ 2⌉` Cycles. Inside:

stages.name: Dry Skin
stages.text: Hypertonic and Acidic regions are neutral for you (on top of *Hardened*). +1 soak vs Lytic, and Leaking effects on you close at your turn's end.

stages.name: Withering Touch
stages.text: In a Dry Zone your Strikes drain: **+2 BD**, and each hit gives you **1 Brine**. Against swarms, each Segment removed also gives 1 Brine.

stages.name: Dust Field
stages.text: Your Dry Zone also **suppresses regeneration and Segment regrowth**, prevents new hazards or spores from forming inside it, and makes any hostile **Sustained Reaction** cost +1 ATP per Cycle. Specialists are hired by colonies to *unmake* things.

stages.name: Salt the Earth
stages.text: Once per Tide, choose a region (up to 100 Drifts across). It becomes permanently **Dry** until you release it: no regeneration, no growth, no healing for hostile organisms; travel costs +1 PP for everyone else; nothing there will ever bloom again. **This is a world-altering act.** The Deep Choir will consider you kin or an abomination, the Flow Guilds will put a price on you, and any colony downstream will send an army. Use it in play only with the table's explicit consent.

phenotypes.kit: Suture Cannon (as a weird heal-delivery tool), Barbed Launcher, Scent Dampener, Vacuole Sac.

adaptations.name: Twin Reserve
adaptations.text: You may hold 2 Reserve PP; each can be spent once per Cycle on a different Reactive Osmosis

adaptations.name: Momentum Banker
adaptations.text: Momentum persists if you move 2+ Drifts on your next turn

adaptations.name: Etched Hide
adaptations.text: Corrodes, Brittle, and Acidic surges can never drop your soak below 2

adaptations.name: Vent Master
adaptations.text: Vent clears 3 Stress and one condition for 1 PP

adaptations.name: Chemical Literacy
adaptations.text: +1 Sequence Reading rank; learn one Burst free

adaptations.name: Antigen Discipline
adaptations.text: +2 dice on all saves against Genetic effects and Hijacks

adaptations.name: Burst Efficiency
adaptations.text: Pick a domain: its Bursts cost −2 ATP (min 1)

adaptations.name: Sustained Control
adaptations.text: Your Sustained Reactions cost no Stress; you may hold two

adaptations.name: Overdrive Training
adaptations.text: Overdrive costs 3 ATP / 3 MI; you may Overdrive twice per Cycle (different rolls)

adaptations.name: Pressure Nerves
adaptations.text: Ignore the first hazard or environmental damage each scene; +2 Pressure Tolerance

adaptations.name: Harvest Hands
adaptations.text: Harvest checks +2 dice; on Overflow 4+ gain one extra Specimen grade

adaptations.name: Current Reader
adaptations.text: Currents never force saves against you; +2 Drifts in any Flow

adaptations.name: Symbiotic Authority
adaptations.text: +1 creature under control; your minions gain +1 PP

adaptations.name: Second Organ
adaptations.text: Once per Tide, when you would drop to 0 MI, drop to 1 MI instead and mark 2 Countdown boxes

adaptations.name: Oathkeeper
adaptations.text: +1 Oath box; keeping an Oath that costs you gives +1 Cohesion and clears 1 Stress

adaptations.name: Autophagic Control
adaptations.text: While in Autophagy you mark no Countdown boxes (2 Stress per Cycle instead)

adaptations.name: Graft Mastery
adaptations.text: +1 Graft Slot (on top of your Stage slots)

adaptations.name: Chimeric Growth
adaptations.text: Take another Phenotype's Stage I feature (and its granted Pathway at rank 1). Requires Stage II. Prerequisite: you must have been *harvested* by or of that tradition at least once
